title: Ligustrazine promotes hypoxia/reoxygenation-treated trophoblast cell proliferation and migration by regulating the microRNA-27a-3p/ATF3 axis.
authors: Wang, Min; Zhang, Li; Huang, Xiuyan; Sun, Qian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究川芎嗪通过miR-27a-3p/ATF3轴调控Wnt通路影响滋养层细胞功能，属于纯细胞实验与临床疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Preeclampsia (PE) is a pregnancy-specific syndrome. Ligustrazine (LSZ) is involved in hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R)-treated trophoblast cell regulation, but its mechanism remains elusive. This study explored the mechanism of LSZ in H/R-treated trophoblast cells to provide a theoretical basis for the new treatment method development for PE. METHODS: H/R HTR8/SVneo cell model was established for PE simulation to some extent. Trophoblast cell proliferation, apoptosis rate, migration, and invasion were detected by MTT assay, flow cytometry, scratch test, and Transwell assay. miR-27a-3p expression in trophoblast cells was detected by RT-qPCR. Binding sites between miR-27a-3p and ATF3 were predicted using Starbase and verified by dual-luciferase reporter assay. Activating transcription factor 3 (ATF3), beta-catenin, Cyclin D1, and c-Myc protein levels were examined using Western blot. After LSZ treatment, H/R-induced HTR8/SVneo cells were delivered with miR-27a-3p mimic or ATF3 siRNA to verify their roles in HTR8/SVneo cells. RESULTS: LSZ facilitated the proliferation, migration, and invasion of trophoblast cells and inhibited apoptosis. miR-27a-3p was elevated in H/R-induced HTR8/SVneo cells and miR-27a-3p overexpression annulled the effect of LSZ on trophoblast cells. miR-27a-3p targeted ATF3. ATF3 silencing averted the property of LSZ on trophoblast cells. Wnt/beta-catenin pathway-related proteins were repressed in H/R-induced HTR8/SVneo cells, and LSZ activated the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway by promoting ATF3 expression. CONCLUSION: LSZ mediated the Wnt pathway by regulating the miR-27a-3p/ATF3 axis, thus promoting the proliferation and migration of trophoblast cells. The protective mechanism of LSZ showed the potential application value in the treatment of PE.
abstract_zh: 目的：子痫前期（PE）是一种妊娠特异性综合征。川芎嗪（LSZ）参与缺氧/复氧（H/R）处理的滋养层细胞调控，但其机制仍不明确。本研究探讨了LSZ在H/R处理的滋养层细胞中的作用机制，为PE新治疗方法的开发提供理论基础。方法：建立H/R HTR8/SVneo细胞模型，在一定程度上模拟PE。通过MTT实验、流式细胞术、划痕实验和Transwell实验检测滋养层细胞增殖、凋亡率、迁移和侵袭。通过RT-qPCR检测滋养层细胞中miR-27a-3p表达。使用Starbase预测miR-27a-3p与ATF3之间的结合位点，并通过双荧光素酶报告实验验证。使用Western blot检测激活转录因子3（ATF3）、β-catenin、Cyclin D1和c-Myc蛋白水平。LSZ处理后，向H/R诱导的HTR8/SVneo细胞转染miR-27a-3p模拟物或ATF3 siRNA，以验证其在HTR8/SVneo细胞中的作用。结果：LSZ促进滋养层细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并抑制凋亡。miR-27a-3p在H/R诱导的HTR8/SVneo细胞中升高，且miR-27a-3p过表达抵消了LSZ对滋养层细胞的作用。miR-27a-3p靶向ATF3。ATF3沉默逆转了LSZ对滋养层细胞的作用。Wnt/β-catenin通路相关蛋白在H/R诱导的HTR8/SVneo细胞中受到抑制，而LSZ通过促进ATF3表达激活了Wnt/β-catenin通路。结论：LSZ通过调控miR-27a-3p/ATF3轴介导Wnt通路，从而促进滋养层细胞增殖和迁移。LSZ的保护机制在PE治疗中显示出潜在应用价值。
